entities.summary: Donna Fern Edwards is an American politician who served as the U.S. representative for Maryland's 4th congressional district from 2008 to 2017. The district included most of Prince George's County, as well as part of Anne Arundel County. She is a member of the Democratic Party. Donna Edwards was a legal figures from Yanceyville (b. 1958-06-28, Yanceyville). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
